taxonomy.name: delivery_tracking_delay
taxonomy.definition: Customer inquiring about package location, late/missed delivery dates, tracking updates, carrier logistics, or marked delivered but not received.
inclusion_criteria: Mentions tracking number, carrier (USPS, UPS, DPD, Hermes, etc.)
Order is late, delayed, or stuck in transit
Status says 'delivered' but package is missing from front door/porch
Queries about estimated arrival time or driver access codes
exclusion_criteria: Customer explicitly demands to return a damaged item (use return_and_replacement)
Customer asking to cancel the order before delivery (use refund_and_cancellation)
Severe rage demanding supervisor/legal action for repeated support failures (use service_complaint_escalation)
examples: Where is my package? The tracking has not updated in 3 days.
Tracking says delivered to front door but nothing is there.
My order was supposed to arrive yesterday before 8pm.
Why did the carrier claim access code was needed when I provided it?

taxonomy.name: return_and_replacement
taxonomy.definition: Customer wanting to return an item, reporting broken/defective/damaged goods, receiving the wrong item, or requesting a replacement.
inclusion_criteria: Item arrived broken, spoiled, wet, or defective
Wrong product, color, or quantity was delivered
Asking how to return an item or generate a return label/pickup
Requesting a replacement unit for a faulty order
exclusion_criteria: Asking solely for a refund on a canceled order without return (use refund_and_cancellation)
Item has not arrived yet (use delivery_tracking_delay)
examples: The ceramic mug arrived completely shattered.
I ordered size 10 shoes but you sent size 8. How do I exchange this?
How do I schedule a return pickup for this defective blender?
Received a completely different item than what I paid for.

taxonomy.name: refund_and_cancellation
taxonomy.definition: Customer asking to cancel an order, inquiring about refund processing timelines, or missing refund amounts for canceled/returned goods.
inclusion_criteria: Asking to cancel an active order before or during shipment
Complaining that refund has not appeared in bank account/card
Asking when the refund for a returned item will be processed
Requesting money back due to canceled order
exclusion_criteria: Initial return inquiry with item still in possession (use return_and_replacement)
Unauthorized fraudulent transaction on account (use account_and_payment_security)
examples: Please cancel my order #123-456789 immediately.
I returned the laptop 2 weeks ago and still haven't received my refund.
When will the refund reflect in my credit card?
My order was canceled by seller but money was deducted.

taxonomy.name: prime_and_subscription
taxonomy.definition: Inquiries, charges, or technical problems related to Amazon Prime membership, Prime Video, Prime Music, or Kindle Unlimited subscriptions.
inclusion_criteria: Unexpected annual/monthly Prime membership charge
Requests to cancel or pause Prime subscription
Complaints about Prime 2-day/same-day delivery benefit failures
Technical errors accessing Prime Video, Firestick apps, or Prime Music
exclusion_criteria: General delivery delays on non-Prime items without subscription complaint (use delivery_tracking_delay)
examples: I was charged $119 for Amazon Prime without my consent.
How do I cancel my Prime subscription and get a prorated refund?
Prime Video is showing error code 5004 on my smart TV.
Why am I paying for Prime when deliveries take a week?

taxonomy.name: account_and_payment_security
taxonomy.definition: Account authentication issues, OTP/verification delays, password reset, payment method declines, gift card balance issues, or fraud/unauthorized access.
inclusion_criteria: Unable to sign in or locked out of account
Not receiving 2FA SMS/email verification OTP codes
Payment declined, card transaction failed, or unexpected charge on unknown account
Gift card code not working or balance not applied
exclusion_criteria: Routine subscription renewal charge for Prime (use prime_and_subscription)
Refund processing query for legitimate return (use refund_and_cancellation)
examples: I cannot log in because the OTP is not coming to my registered phone.
My card was charged $45 by Amazon but I placed no order.
Why is my account placed on hold when I try to checkout?
Gift card code says already redeemed but balance is zero.

taxonomy.name: service_complaint_escalation
taxonomy.definition: Customer expressing acute dissatisfaction with customer service reps, unresolved repeated contacts, unfulfilled promises, or demanding human management.
inclusion_criteria: Repeated complaints ('4th time contacting you', 'no one is resolving this')
Agent rudeness, disconnected chats, or broken callback commitments
Explicit demand for a human supervisor, manager, or legal/regulatory escalation
Strong emotional distress/anger regarding service failure
exclusion_criteria: Routine delivery delay without customer service complaint (use delivery_tracking_delay)
Standard refund inquiry without prior representative failure (use refund_and_cancellation)
examples: Your customer care is pathetic, 3 agents disconnected my chat today!
I've been following up for 3 weeks and getting nothing but false promises.
I want to speak with a human manager immediately.
Worst customer service ever, nobody is responding to my emails.

taxonomy.name: general_product_inquiry
taxonomy.definition: General inquiries about product availability, stock restock dates, pricing discrepancies, promo codes, seller queries, or website navigation.
inclusion_criteria: Asking when an item will be back in stock or available for pre-order
Questions regarding promotional discounts, coupons, or lightning deals
Clarifications on product specifications, warranty, or manufacturer support
General questions on policy or international shipping availability
exclusion_criteria: Specific problems with an already placed order (use delivery_tracking_delay or return_and_replacement)
examples: When will the Kindle Paperwhite be back in stock in the UK?
Does the advertised discount code apply to third-party sellers?
Can this product be shipped to Australia?
Is there a manufacturer warranty included with this refurbished laptop?
